notes: Recognizable illustrated game icons across the arcade and game menus: numbered Sudoku grid, Wordle tiles, matching memory cards, Recall brain and answer prompt, Letter Lab tiles, Hangman gallows, Answer Catcher basket and nested tic-tac-toe board. Adds an always-visible Sudoku rankings preview, automatic saved scores for solved puzzles and Top charts by difficulty. Scoring uses difficulty points plus a speed bonus minus mistake and hint penalties; separate solo, shared and race boards with assisted results separated. Existing saved Sudoku records are retained.
